title: Responsibilities
description: Duty plans: who is responsible when, with shift templates and shifts.
newDescription: Saved as a draft; it shows under “Responsibilities” once it is published.
emptyHint: Create the first one, for example “Key service”.

name.label: Name of the duty
name.hint: For example “Key service” or “Shift lead, early shift, hall 2”.

note.label: Note
note.hint: Shown with the responsibility, for example “Keys in box 3”.

department.label: Department
department.hint: Department heads and team leads of this department maintain the plan too.

shiftTemplates.hint: Fixed shift times. An end before the start ends on the next day.
shiftTemplates.invalid: Every template needs a unique label and two different times.
shiftTemplates.tooLong: A label may have at most 60 characters.

shifts.hint: Shifts that ended more than four weeks ago are removed when you save.
shifts.copyWeekHint: Copies the shifts of the week from the chosen Monday into the week after.
shifts.copied: {count, plural, =0 {There are no shifts in this week.} one {One shift copied.} other {# shifts copied.}}
shifts.peopleFailed: The directory could not be loaded. Existing shifts are kept.
shifts.overlap: Overlap: {first} and {second} are on duty at the same time. That is allowed, but please check it.
shifts.invalid: Every shift needs a person, a day and valid times.
shifts.endBeforeStart: A shift ends before it starts or lasts longer than 14 days.
